ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var pqrTechnology = vars.pqrHomologatedResponse.result[0].'tecnologia_pqr' default "" --- vars.botOriginalRequest ++ "_" ++ pqrTechnology

when.expression: #[isEmpty(vars.serviceResponse.result default []) and isEmpty(vars.serviceActiveResponse.result default []) and (upper(vars.origin.system.Sistema_Origen default '') contains 'MAX')]

raise-error.description: Services not related for the indicated number, please check serviceAccountId or orderNumber provided.

validation:is-false.doc:name: validate owner docType
validation:is-false.message: The customer's document type does not match the ownership data found.

validation:is-false.doc:name: validate owner docNumber
validation:is-false.message: The customer's document number does not match the ownership data found.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var keyValue = (vars.pqrTypologyFilter pluck ((value) -> value) joinBy ":") --- "PQR_TIPOLOGIA:" ++ keyValue

validation:is-false.doc:name: validate pqr typology
validation:is-false.message: No typology related to the PQR data

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var pqrTypology = vars.pqrTypologyResponse.result[0] --- { causal: pqrTypology.causal, class: pqrTypology.clase, reason: pqrTypology.motivo, symptom: pqrTypology.'sintoma', product: pqrTypology.producto, description: vars.initialPayload.ticket.pqr.failure.description default "NO_DESCRIPTION", requiresCun: pqrTypology.'requiere_cun', requiresRemedy: pqrTypology.'requiere_remedy', remedyStatus: pqrTypology.remedy }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- (vars.pqrHistoryResponse.result default []) filter ( (item) -> ( item.'causal_pqr' == vars.pqr.causal and item.'clase_pqr' == vars.pqr.class and item.'motivo_pqr' == vars.pqr.reason and item.'sintoma_pqr' == vars.pqr.symptom and upper(item.estado_pqr) == "ABIERTA"))

raise-error.description: Duplicated PQR - already exists with CUN: #[vars.duplicatePqr[0].cun default ""]

logger.doc:name: New PQR
logger.message: The current PQR is a new ticket, validating parentship
